## Admission Counselling Process

Your strategic path from registration to institute reporting.

#### Registration

Registration for CET/NEET Counselling Portal and initial profile setup.

#### Verification

Upload documents for online or physical scrutiny and verification.

#### Merit List

Check eligibility and merit ranking to define your college category strategy.

#### Choice Filling

Strategic preference locking using our proprietary cut-off intelligence.

#### Seat Allotment

Analysis of allotment results and deciding between Freeze or Float.

#### Betterment

Optimizing upgrades in subsequent rounds for a better institution.

#### Reporting

Final institute reporting and completion of seat confirmation formalities.
